content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG) introduced and administers the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 scheme [E01][E02]. The ministry is responsible for launching the scheme, which was expanded under Ujjwala 2.0 to provide additional LPG connections to deprived households [E01].
